//@version=6
indicator("const color accessor numeric defaults")
A = color.new(#336699,70.9)
B = color.rgb(51,102,153,70.9)
C = #3366994b
x0 = input.float(color.t(color.new(#336699,70.9)), title="new-direct")
x1 = input.float(color.t(color.rgb(51,102,153,70.9)), title="rgb-direct")
x2 = input.float(color.t(#3366994b), title="hex-direct")
x3 = input.float(color.t(A), title="new-alias")
x4 = input.float(color.t(B), title="rgb-alias")
x5 = input.float(color.t(C), title="hex-alias")
x6 = input.float(color.t(color.rgb(51,102,153,70.25)), title="rgb-fraction")
x7 = input.float(color.t(#3366994c), title="hex76")
x8 = input.float(color.t(#33669901), title="hex01")
plot(close)
